verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads are a fair question for a state registry agency, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an interactive corporation database search and per-request paid copies or search reports. Nothing shows a downloadable dataset, registry extract, or bulk file, and the API and llms.txt probes returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
